query.value: SELECT AIRLINE_ID, AIRLINE_NAME, COUNTRY, SOURCE_FILE_NAME, INGESTION_TIMESTAMP FROM BRONZE.DIMAIRLINE WHERE INGESTION_TIMESTAMP > '@{activity('Lookup_Watermark').output.firstRow.LASTPROCESSEDTIMESTAMP}'

SELECT
    MAX(INGESTION_TIMESTAMP) AS lastProcessedTimestamp
FROM BRONZE.DIMAIRLINE
WHERE INGESTION_TIMESTAMP >
'@{activity('Lookup_Watermark').output.firstRow.lastProcessedTimestamp}'

text.value:
MERGE INTO SILVER.DIMAIRLINE AS target
USING STAGING.DIMAIRLINE AS source
ON target.AIRLINE_ID = source.AIRLINE_ID

WHEN MATCHED AND (
    NOT EQUAL_NULL(target.AIRLINE_NAME, source.AIRLINE_NAME)
    OR NOT EQUAL_NULL(target.COUNTRY, source.COUNTRY)
    OR NOT EQUAL_NULL(target.SOURCE_FILE_NAME, source.SOURCE_FILE_NAME)
) THEN
    UPDATE SET
        AIRLINE_NAME        = source.AIRLINE_NAME,
        COUNTRY             = source.COUNTRY,
        SOURCE_FILE_NAME    = source.SOURCE_FILE_NAME,
        INGESTION_TIMESTAMP = source.INGESTION_TIMESTAMP

WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
    INSERT (
        AIRLINE_ID,
        AIRLINE_NAME,
        COUNTRY,
        SOURCE_FILE_NAME,
        INGESTION_TIMESTAMP
    )
    VALUES (
        source.AIRLINE_ID,
        source.AIRLINE_NAME,
        source.COUNTRY,
        source.SOURCE_FILE_NAME,
        source.INGESTION_TIMESTAMP
    );
